recentItems.title: The 11th Belt and Road Summit
recentItems.description: The 11th Belt and Road Summit, co-organised by the Hong Kong SAR Government and the HKTDC, is held on 9-10 September 2026 at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre. Under the theme “Advancing High-Quality Development • Embarking on a New Journey”, the Summit brings together more than 100 government officials, business leaders and professionals from Belt and Road countries and regions to jointly explore new opportunities in high-quality Belt and Road development, to promote cross-regional trade and industrial matching, and accelerate the implementation of concrete outcomes.

CENTRESTAGE, Hong Kong Watch & Clock Fair and Salon de TIME 2026
recentItems.description:
CENTRESTAGE, Asia’s annual premier fashion event and a flagship programme of the third edition of Hong Kong Fashion Fest, is held at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre on 2-5 September 2026. Organised by the HKTDC and sponsored by CCIDA of the Hong Kong SAR Government, this year's CENTRESTAGE has attracted a record-breaking convergence of some 270 international brands from 24 countries and regions. This vibrant tapestry of style encompasses renowned labels, emerging designers, and industry elites, showcasing the pinnacle of fashion trends and creative ingenuity. 

The 45th Hong Kong Watch & Clock Fair and the 14th Salon de TIME, jointly organised by the HKTDC, Hong Kong Watch Manufacturers Association Limited and The Federation of Hong Kong Watch Trades & Industries Limited, is held at the HKCEC on 1-5 September under the theme “Sparkling Moments Through Time”. The twin fairs have attracted more than 630 exhibitors from 16 countries and regions, creating the world's largest one-stop watch and clock marketplace.

recentItems.title: Fashion Hong Kong Runway @ CENTRESTAGE 2026
recentItems.description:
Layered. Fast.
City energy, stitched into every seam.
That's Hong Kong.

This year's show is all about "Hong Kong Dopamine" — channeling the city's neon lights, rush hour energy, quiet alleyways — into clothes that hit different.
Think vibrant, experimental, and a little bit wild.

recentItems.title: AFF 2026 Highlight: Co-creating new horizons amid an evolving landscape
recentItems.description:
“Hong Kong is in fact one of the most important financial centres in the world.” This powerful sentiment from a participant captured the energy and optimism at #AFF2026.

This year, the Asian Financial Forum brought over 4,000 political and business leaders from more than 60 countries and regions. European voices were particularly strong in calling for deeper cooperation with China in trade, investment and sustainable development.

recentItems.title: Hear from exhibitors at Food Expo, Beauty and Wellness Expo and Int’l Tea Fair 2026
recentItems.description:
Hear from exhibitors at this year’s HKTDC Food Expo, Food Expo PRO, Beauty & Wellness Expo and Hong Kong International Tea Fair about how the fairs brought together suppliers, buyers and customers from Hong Kong, the Chinese Mainland and

around the world, provided promotional opportunities for a diverse range of food and lifestyle products, facilitated business connections, and allowed participants to leverage Hong Kong’s advantages as a trade and services hub.
